title: Reliable Workspace Header
notes: Forces the current workspace interface code to load inside the Shot Diagram instead of reusing an older cached frame copy.
Separates workspace controls from the document information and sync-status bar and measures the rendered header as a safety check.
Removes every legacy Finish and Send to Blaster control by class, id, action, or label.
Removes the old UNSENT and shared-to-Outlook wording from the workspace detail line; cloud status is now authoritative.
Keeps PDF, CSV, and backup exports available from the document menu.
Preserves the verified m40.8.0 field-entry UI, m40.7.1 cloud loading, and m40.6.2 iPad touch behavior.
